strategy.base: QQQ 165-day SMA regime, 100% TQQQ risk-on / BIL risk-off, 4% intraday stop armed when QQQ 09:30 < MA20*1.01
strategy.overlay: on ex-ante event sessions keep the overnight TQQQ leg and hold the de-risk asset from the 09:31 open to the 15:59 open
strategy.calendar_source: Fed FOMC calendars; BLS CPI/Employment-Situation release schedules (archived bls.gov pages); OpEx = 3rd Friday (holiday-shifted); pre-holiday = last session before a NYSE full-day holiday
